clips.prompt: A painterly, warmly lit animated scene in the style of a modern illustrated storybook, soft brush textures. A grand early-1800s dining hall in Vienna, chandeliers glowing. A king in a rich uniform, seen from behind and in profile, gestures kindly as a servant sets a silver tray of glossy golden pretzels on a long table of elegant guests, who lean in curiously. Gentle, comic, festive mood. No face turned to the camera, no text.
clips.credit: Story two: a Bavarian king and lye pretzels in Vienna: made with Gemini Omni

clips.prompt: A painterly, warmly lit animated close-up in the style of a modern illustrated storybook, soft brush textures. Overhead view of a dull grey aluminium baking tray on a wooden table. A pale liquid is poured over it, the metal surface slowly clouds, and tiny silver flecks drift into the liquid. A piece of pretzel dough is placed on the tray and a few flecks cling to its underside. Calm, curious, slightly worrying mood. No people, no text.
clips.credit: Lye and an aluminium tray: made with Gemini Omni
